notes:
- **The Assistant works as a team**: requests with several parts (for example a sword, a block and armor, or a boss with its model and animations) are planned first, then a code worker writes the code and an assets & data worker writes the names, models, recipes and art descriptions. The app checks the result and sends any problem back to the worker that made it. Simple requests and questions still get one quick answer. Turn it off in the Full build menu ("Team mode").
- **Full build verification**: after a Full build the app can test your project itself - Quick (static checks and a build), Deep (also a local test server with real in-game tests and a look at every texture and model) or Vision only. What fails is repaired automatically, a limited number of times, and changes that make things worse are undone. Choose the mode in Full build > Verification; Deep needs a paid plan.
- **Tests planned by the AI**: in Deep verification the AI reads what your project contains - blocks, items, weapons with ammo and cooldowns, mobs and bosses, machines, menus, recipes, commands - and plans the tests for each one itself, including edge cases. Every planned test is checked for safety before it runs.
- **Find picture**: the Texture Studio can search free CC0 reference pictures (Poly Haven) for a block and put the best one on the texture. Turn on "AI auto-select images" to let the AI choose the picture for you.
- **Steadier with a busy AI service**: when the AI service asks the app to slow down, every part of the app now waits together and tries again by itself instead of failing.
- **Smarter repairs**: fixes that were verified before are now given to the Assistant first when the same error comes back.
